children: Adamas Trust declared cash dividends on its Series D, E, F and G preferred shares for the July 15–Oct 14, 2026 period.
Board declared cash dividends for dividend period July 15–October 14, 2026 on Series D–G preferred stock.
Record date for all Series D, E, F and G is October 1, 2026; payment date is October 15, 2026.
Cash dividend per share: Series D $0.50; Series E $0.6672255; Series F $0.4296875; Series G $0.4375.
Press release filed as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference in the Form 8-K.
